description: Personal voice memo and daily notes app with transcription, playback, and a stunning dynamic UI. Built for Hayden to capture thoughts via voice or text.

userStories.title: Initialize project structure
userStories.description: Create the base HTML/CSS/JS structure with modern tooling
acceptanceCriteria: Create index.html with proper HTML5 structure
Create styles.css with CSS variables for theming
userStories.notes: Keep it vanilla JS - no build step needed. Modern ES6+ modules.

userStories.title: Design stunning base UI layout
userStories.description: Create a visually impressive, modern interface that wows
acceptanceCriteria: Dark mode by default with rich color palette
Sidebar for navigation, main content area for notes
userStories.notes: Make it look like a premium app. Surprise Hayden with the aesthetics.

userStories.title: Implement IndexedDB storage layer
userStories.description: Create robust local storage using IndexedDB
acceptanceCriteria: Create 'notes' object store with auto-increment id
Create 'voiceMemos' object store for audio blobs
Implement CRUD functions: createNote, getNote, updateNote, deleteNote
userStories.notes: IndexedDB handles large binary data (audio) well. Use async/await wrapper.

userStories.title: Build daily notes feature
userStories.description: Text note creation with daily organization
acceptanceCriteria: Rich text editor or nice textarea for writing
userStories.notes: This is the core feature. Make writing feel good.

userStories.title: Implement voice recording
acceptanceCriteria: Record button with visual feedback (pulsing when active)
Handle errors gracefully (no mic, permission denied)
userStories.notes: Use MediaRecorder API. Store as webm or mp3.

userStories.title: Implement voice playback
acceptanceCriteria: List all voice memos for current day
Visual audio waveform or progress indicator
userStories.notes: Use HTML5 Audio API. Make playback controls intuitive.

userStories.title: Implement voice transcription
userStories.description: Transcribe voice memos using Web Speech API
acceptanceCriteria: Use SpeechRecognition API for real-time transcription
Handle browsers without speech recognition support
userStories.notes: Web Speech API is free and built-in. Falls back gracefully.

userStories.title: Add micro-interactions and polish
acceptanceCriteria: Loading states with skeletons or spinners
Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+N for new note, etc)
userStories.notes: The details make it feel premium.

userStories.title: Calendar/timeline view
userStories.description: Navigate notes by date with visual calendar
acceptanceCriteria: Click date to view that day's notes
userStories.notes: Makes browsing past notes easy and visual.

userStories.title: Final testing and polish
acceptanceCriteria: All features work without console errors
UI looks great at different screen sizes
